Apple AirTag Brieftaschenkarte

https://makerworld.com/de/models/1018681-apple-airtag-wallet-card#profileId-999521

Convert an Apple AirTag to fit in a wallet and double its battery life. The card is just under 4 mm thick, making it half the thickness of a regular AirTag.

Materials:

* Apple AirTag
* Soldering iron and solder
* Copper tape
* Extra CR2032 Battery
* (Optional) Safety glasses and helping hand
 

 

Instructions:

* Teardown:

* Carefully follow a teardown guide, such as this one on iFixit: https://www.ifixit.com/News/50145/airtag-teardown-part-one-yeah-this-tracks
* During teardown, focus on removing the speaker's copper coil without damaging it. So it can be used as a speaker. 

* Battery Connection:

* Important: Ensure both positive connectors are soldered together for proper functionality.

* Cut a small piece of wide copper tape and use it to connect the negative terminals of both batteries. Solder the negative wire from the AirTag to this copper tape connection.

* Cut a thin, longer piece of copper tape to connect the positive terminals. Solder the positive wire from the AirTag to this thin copper tape.
 

Boost MeIf you like this mod please give me a like or Boost

Druckeinstellungen:
- Druckprofil: 0.16mm layer, 2 walls, 15% infill
- Schichthöhe: 0.16 mm
- Wandlinien: 2
- Infill: 15%
- Filament: PLA (#042F56)
